'''Einstein Toolkit: 3+1 Numerical Relativity Solver'''
[[Category:Principia Machina]] [[Category:Tools]]

== Overview & Architectural Fit ==
The '''Einstein Toolkit''' is a community-driven software suite for numerical relativity, relativistic astrophysics, and dynamic spacetime geometry based on the Cactus computational infrastructure.

== Mathematical Evaluation for TPM & SVD ==
* '''3+1 ADM/BSSN Spacetime Evolution (9.5/10):''' Evolves the full Einstein Field Equations (<math>G_{\mu\nu} = \frac{8\pi G}{c^4} T_{\mu\nu}</math>) dynamically across 3D spatial grids.
* '''Strong-Field General Relativity:''' Simulates black hole mergers, dynamic metric perturbations, and gravitational wave emission.
